# Verification matrix

| Claim | Method | Command/scenario | Result | Artifact |
|:------|:-------|:-----------------|:------:|---------:|
| API exists | source inspection | public interface | Verified | Source |
| App fold | unit test | nested state | Passing | Test log |
| Facade behavior | scripted integration | mixed response | Verified | Receipt |
| Restart/recovery | persistent restart | process handoff | Passing | Session |
| Platform parity | native suite | light and dark | Verified | Screenshot |

## Failure-path coverage

- [ ] Source unavailable remains explicit.
- [x] Mixed relay response stays distinguishable.
- [ ] Missing signer pins expected identity.
- [x] Receipt observation cancellation is bounded.
- [ ] At-most-once ambiguity is not retried blindly.
